note: Per-plugin boot evidence, graded against a boot this project performed itself. 'started' is the line the plugin prints when it reaches a working state; 'announces' is the loosest line that proves the plugin ran at all; 'failed' plus 'recovered' expresses a fixable-at-boot warning (the browser plugin warns before the tool registry activates and registers afterwards, so the warning alone is not a failure). A plugin with no 'started' marker is UNGRADED, not healthy: the browser-half plugins print nothing at kernel boot and are graded by the live gates instead.
